declared_limits: Every claim fixes callvalue 0, a top-level non-static frame, and gas not modelled: a claim holds for executions that do not run out of gas (Aasm-gas-abstraction). It does not guarantee termination within any gas limit.
Every claim is proved under KEVM <schedule> OSAKA </schedule>, which models mainnet osaka only partly (trusted_base.json semantics[0].adequacy_evidence, A1).
